== triggers
CREATE TRIGGER library_entries_init_activity BEFORE INSERT ON public.library_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION library_entries_init_activity()
CREATE TRIGGER library_entry_completion BEFORE UPDATE ON public.library_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION library_entry_completion()
CREATE TRIGGER progress_events_touch_entry AFTER INSERT ON public.progress_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION progress_events_touch_entry()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_entry_changed AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.library_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_entry_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_events_deleted AFTER DELETE ON public.progress_events REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_events_deleted()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_events_inserted AFTER INSERT ON public.progress_events REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_events_inserted()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_events_updated AFTER UPDATE ON public.progress_events REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_events_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_item_changed AFTER UPDATE ON public.catalog_items FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.kind IS DISTINCT FROM new.kind) OR ((old.attributes -> 'runtime_minutes'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (new.attributes -> 'runtime_minutes'::text)) OR ((old.attributes -> 'episode_runtime_minutes'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (new.attributes -> 'episode_runtime_minutes'::text)))) EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_item_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_sessions_deleted AFTER DELETE ON public.sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_sessions_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_sessions_inserted AFTER INSERT ON public.sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_sessions_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_sessions_updated AFTER UPDATE ON public.sessions FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.duration_minutes IS DISTINCT FROM new.duration_minutes) OR (old.item_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.item_id) OR (old.owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.owner_id))) EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_sessions_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER stats_users_deleted AFTER DELETE ON public.stats_users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stats_users_deleted()
== functions
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jsonb_u64(j jsonb)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j) = 'number' AND (j #>> '{}') ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
                THEN (j #>> '{}')::bigint END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.library_activity(p_user uuid, p_item uuid, OUT last_at timestamp with time zone, OUT plays integer)
 RETURNS record
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT max(x.occurred_at),
           (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x.progress ->> 'type' = 'session'))::integer
    FROM progress_events x
    WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.item_id = p_item AND x.undoes IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM progress_events u WHERE u.undoes = x.id)
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.library_entries_init_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    SELECT a.last_at, a.plays INTO NEW.last_event_at, NEW.plays
    FROM library_activity(NEW.user_id, NEW.item_id) a;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.library_entry_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.status = 'completed' AND NEW.status = 'completed'
       AND OLD.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
        NEW.completed_at := OLD.completed_at;
        NEW.completed_undated := false;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.progress_events_touch_entry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE library_entries e SET (last_event_at, plays) =
        (SELECT a.last_at, a.plays FROM library_activity(NEW.user_id, NEW.item_id) a)
    WHERE e.user_id = NEW.user_id AND e.item_id = NEW.item_id;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_entry_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        IF (OLD.completed_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.completed_undated)
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = OLD.user_id) THEN
            INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id) VALUES (OLD.user_id, OLD.item_id)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        IF NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.completed_undated THEN
            INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id) VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.item_id)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
        END IF;
    ELSIF OLD.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.completed_at
          OR OLD.completed_undated IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.completed_undated THEN
        INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id) VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.item_id)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_events_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id)
    SELECT DISTINCT p.user_id, p.item_id FROM (
        SELECT o.user_id, o.item_id FROM old_rows o
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n.user_id, n.item_id FROM new_rows n
    ) p
    ORDER BY 1, 2
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_events_deleted()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id)
    SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id, o.item_id FROM old_rows o
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = o.user_id)
    ORDER BY 1, 2
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_events_inserted()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id)
    SELECT DISTINCT p.user_id, p.item_id FROM (
        SELECT n.user_id, n.item_id FROM new_rows n
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n.user_id, t.item_id FROM new_rows n JOIN progress_events t ON t.id = n.undoes
    ) p
    ORDER BY 1, 2
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_item_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id)
    SELECT p.user_id, NEW.id FROM (
        SELECT x.user_id FROM progress_events x WHERE x.item_id = NEW.id
        UNION
        SELECT e.user_id FROM library_entries e
        WHERE e.item_id = NEW.id AND (e.completed_at IS NOT NULL OR e.completed_undated)
    ) p
    ORDER BY 1, 2
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_sessions_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = OLD.owner_id) THEN
        INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id) VALUES (OLD.owner_id, OLD.item_id)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN
        INSERT INTO stats_dirty (user_id, item_id) VALUES (NEW.owner_id, NEW.item_id)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET gen = EXCLUDED.gen;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_users_deleted()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM stats_item_months WHERE user_id = OLD.user_id;
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

outbox_id_seq bigint start 1 min 1 max 9223372036854775807 by 1 cycle false cache 1 owned by outbox.id
stats_dirty_gen bigint start 1 min 1 max 9223372036854775807 by 1 cycle false cache 1
